questions.skillLabel: Accuracy versus IoU on imbalanced masks

questions.prompt: For one class, 30 pixels are correct, the ground truth has 50 pixels of that class and the prediction has 40. Compute its IoU (precision 0.01).
A class has IoU 0.5. Compute its Dice score (precision 0.001).
A segmenter reaches 98% pixel accuracy but the 'person' class covers 1% of pixels. What is the correct reading?
questions.skillLabel: Accuracy versus IoU on imbalanced masks
options: Accuracy is dominated by background; check per-class IoU and recall for person
The model is overfitted, because accuracy this high cannot be real
98% means the model segments people well, since accuracy covers every class
Accuracy and IoU are always equal for each class, so 98% is enough

questions.prompt: You downsample a label mask with class ids 0, 1, 2 for a faster network. Which interpolation is correct?
options: Average pooling on the label ids
questions.explanation: Averaging ids creates labels that are not in the image (0 and 2 give 1).

questions.prompt: How many connected components does the mask [[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]] have under 8-connectivity? (integer)
questions.explanation: Diagonal neighbours are connected in 8-connectivity (3 components in 4-connectivity).
